picks.what: The Prospect of the Town of Dundee from the East, engraving in John Slezer’s Theatrum Scotiae
picks.why: true general view across the Tay with the Old Steeple, harbor and the Law; very high resolution; caption cut

gaps: P0, P1, P3, P5, P6: nothing usable
notes: #3 (Dundee from the Law, Valentine photograph in The City of Dundee Illustrated, 1880s) is a good general view but only about 33 years from the existing 1852 Old Steeple lithograph; kept the colored lithograph rather than replace it. P6: #12 and #13 are 360° and 18:1 strip panoramas (city square, Tay Rail Bridge) that cannot give a 16:9 card. Others are Dundee, Illinois; Dundee Island; dundee boats; Valentine’s of Dundee postcards of other places; a presbytery group portrait.
